title: Kishiwada Castle
axis: Local +X points from the gate across the inner ward toward the main keep and its eastern parapet. Local +Z runs from the lower keep toward the south side of the main keep.

nativeAxes.x: gateward side toward the main keep and eastern curtain
nativeAxes.z: subsidiary keep toward the main keep’s south edge

features.role: Named main keep footprint, with smaller keep, revetments, curtain, gate and moat shore in documented nearby native features.

identityStatus: Named native keeps, separately drawn adjacent walls and moat shore, official city reconstruction records, and cleared photographs from both visible faces.

terrainContact.basis: Original grade on the inside of the fortified ward near the principal keep.

notes: A three-tiered white keep with black tile roofs and a smaller linked tower. Battered masonry rises from the moat to capped perimeter walls. The 1969 gate and corner ranges are retained.
